texts.zh:
尽管十分困难，我们还是设法破解了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]所使用语言，从而使初步的沟通成为可能。他们似乎自称是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]。不可避免地，所有交流只能借助于专门针对其语言的通信系统。

任何试图与他们进行流利的沟通的人都似乎绕不开这个问题，但[This.Owner.GetResearchers]有不同看法。在他的鼓动下，鉴于资金仍有剩余，他们起草了一份提案，意图将这次成功行动的经验应用到更广泛的场合中。他们相信，通过对这里使用的软件进行微调，他们将能够构建出他们所称的“通用翻译器”，只要提供足够的信息，就能为任何语言进行同声传译。
texts.en:
Although it proved a considerable challenge, we have managed to decode the form of communication used by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sufficiently to establish preliminary contact. It seems that they call themselves the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]. Inevitably, communication can only happen with the help of communication systems specifically tuned to their language.

This would appear to be problematic for hopes of fluent conversation with them, but our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] see it differently. Buoyed by their success and still benefiting from the extra funding we provided them, they have drawn up a proposal to consolidate our learnings from this experience into something that will be of generally applicable use. They believe that, by fine-tuning the software used here, they will be able to build what they are calling a "universal translator", which - if provided with enough information - will be able to instantaneously suggest translations for phrases uttered in any given language.

label.zh: 无限的沟通机会尽在掌控！
label.en: Unlimited communication possibilities are within our grasp!

texts.zh: 所谓“万能翻译器”的原型机已经成功制成。虽然其效果相较于[This.Owner.GetResearchers]所设想的那种能够即时对任何未知语言进行翻译的设备打了折扣，但仍不失为对现有翻译系统的巨大改进。光明的前景，即解除与包括[contacted_hummers.GetName]在内的任何接触到的外星人的交流障碍，已摆在眼前。
texts.en: Prototyping of the so-called "universal translator" has finished in success. Although the results fall short of the boldest promises of our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] of a device capable of instantly translating even unknown languages, it is a massive improvement over existing translation systems. Already, there are promises of vast boons as barriers to communication with the [contacted_hummers.GetName] and other alien acquaintances are lifted.

texts.zh: 我们的研究人员承诺将利用近来与[contacted_hummers.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的遭遇经历，将作为一个万能的、可即刻将任何给定的语言翻译成我们自己的语言的翻译系统的起点。即使他们最终未能成功，我们也希望他们能够对我们的通讯系统进行显著改进。
texts.en: Our researchers promise that our recent encounter with the [contacted_hummers.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has given them the beginnings of a translation system able to translate any given language into our own instantly. Even if they fall short of this, it is our hope that they will be able to upgrade our communication systems considerably.
